meta_title: Not a Fresho Alternative: Keep Fresho, Add Voice Ordering
meta_desc: Keep Fresho running and add one spoken step: kitchens say the order into an app and confirm each line. A Fresho alternative you add without giving anything up.

hero.h1: Not A Fresho Alternative: Voice Ordering Alongside Fresho
hero.lead: VoiceOrder Solutions gives a voice app to the accounts that still call their orders in. They say what they need into the app, look over each line before it goes, and the order arrives in a format you can use now. Whatever you run on Fresho, from AI order reading to the full suite, carries on.

stats.label: Saved on each order that used to be phoned
Brings the first order from most kitchens

problem.h2: Why distributors weigh an alternative to Fresho
problem.lead: Looking up a Fresho competitor is seldom a complaint about the product. Fresho is an order and operations system with real depth in fresh food. The search usually comes down to how much one vendor should run, or what to change first. Neither one means taking Fresho out.

cards.h3: Fresho can already run most of the operation
cards.body: Fresho reaches from the order through to the payment, and their pricing lets you take only the parts you want. How much of the operation sits with one vendor is a big decision. How some accounts place their order is a small one, and it can be answered on its own.

cards.h3: Some kitchens would happily order a new way
cards.body: Their AI is built so a customer does not have to change a thing. That is a deliberate and sound choice, and for plenty of accounts it is right. A few would still rather say it once and see the lines than leave one more voicemail for a machine to read.

cards.h3: A voice step does not wait on a rollout
cards.body: Fresho publishes its timeline openly: around four weeks to set up, plus two to four weeks training the AI. Giving our app to some accounts is a separate decision. You can do it before, during or after a Fresho rollout.

features.h2: The one step a Fresho alternative adds

rows.h3: Kitchens change how they order, on purpose
rows.body: A chef walks the cooler, says what is short, and the lines come up from that account's guide. They fix anything off and send. It is a change in how they order, and because they fixed the lines themselves, nobody at your end has to rebuild the order afterwards.
bullets: They see the list before a thing is sent
Done in the cooler or at the desk, at any hour
Runs on their own iOS or Android phone, with no device from you
Saves 20 to 30 minutes compared with the same order by phone
Interrupted halfway? It holds the order until they come back

rows.h3: Just your items and your prices
rows.body: Each account gets the products it orders at the price you set for it, under your own codes. That guide is the whole of our setup.
bullets: Lines drawn from the account's own guide
Pricing and the catalog remain yours to control
Change a guide once and the next order carries it
Begin on a handful of accounts and judge it there

rows.h3: It arrives in the software you work in now
rows.body: A finished order arrives as an email carrying a PDF, Excel or Word file, or goes straight into your ERP over the API, over EDI, or into QuickBooks. Whatever sends your invoices and plans your runs today goes on doing it.
bullets: Sent to a named rep, or to the purchasing desk
Over EDI, the API or QuickBooks, nobody on your team retypes it
Carrying a number, with the date and time of sending
No module of yours has to be switched off

rows.h3: Stock in the frame as orders come through
rows.body: VoiceOrder Solutions carries real-time inventory visibility tied to order activity, and the catalog updates as stock levels change. It does not replace your stock system: that stays in charge, and a demo shows how the levels connect.
bullets: Over the full catalog, not only the quick movers
Fewer stockout surprises on a late, heavy order
Stock numbers come from the system you count with today
Counting and buying stay with your own system

cards.h2: Fresho runs the day, VoiceOrder Solutions adds the voice
cards.lead: Keeping both is a sensible setup. We are not a Fresho replacement: some kitchens move their ordering into our app, and everything after the order (picking, delivery and the invoice) stays as it is. A Fresho alternative quite often means precisely this.

items.h3: The back end keeps every job it has
items.body: Invoices, payments, pick lists and the delivery run are not on offer here and are not touched. We hand the completed order over, and the rest of the day stays yours.

items.h3: Let every account choose how it orders
items.body: Customers happy in the portal, or happy leaving a voicemail for OrderPilot, Fresho's AI order reader, carry on just as Fresho promises. Hand the app to the kitchens that would rather talk it through and check it on screen.
No modules to choose and nothing to switch off. Open a few of the accounts that cost you the most time and decide on the evidence.

midcta.h3: Watch one account place a spoken reorder
midcta.body: Twenty minutes. One account, a single order spoken aloud, and nothing else in your operation changes.

steps.h2: Three steps, and no modules to pick
steps.lead: There is no project to plan. You pass us the guides, we load them and set up each account, and your customers get going.

items.body: A spreadsheet covers it. Items and the price per account go into one admin screen, under the codes you already use.
We set up each customer and the kitchen downloads the app. Most will have ordered before the day is finished.
The customer has confirmed it, it is numbered and timed, and it comes in whichever of your formats you chose.

comparison.h2: Fresho, plus a voice reorder. Everything Fresho does, plus one step.
h2_lines: Everything Fresho does, plus one step.
comparison.lead: The two columns show your operation as it runs now, and with spoken orders added for the accounts that want them. Fresho covers ordering, stock, margins, delivery, picking, invoicing and payments. It knows produce, meat and seafood well. So a Fresho alternative is rarely what you actually need. The two products do not connect.

items.q: Is a Fresho alternative what we actually need?
items.a: Usually not. Fresho is an operations system built for perishable wholesale, from the order to the payment, and replacing it just to change how a few kitchens order would be far too big a change. Keep it, and bring in VoiceOrder Solutions for the kitchens happier talking than typing.

items.q: Is VoiceOrder Solutions better than Fresho?
items.a: At delivery runs, invoicing, taking payment, picking, margin control or reporting, not remotely: we do none of them. Where we help is narrower, a kitchen that speaks its order and checks every item before it sends. That sits beside all of Fresho's work rather than competing with it.

items.q: Their AI handles voicemails. Do we need yours too?
items.a: Maybe not for every account, and it is worth being exact because both products involve a voice. Theirs reads a voicemail your customer already left and works the order out of it. Ours has the customer speak into an app that builds the lines from their guide, which they then confirm. That difference, not a missing feature, is why many who look for a Fresho alternative end up keeping both.

items.q: Does VoiceOrder Solutions connect to Fresho?
items.a: No. Nothing connects the two, and neither company supports the other. Both sit beside your ERP on their own terms: theirs through its own ERP connection, while ours arrive by email, EDI, API or as a QuickBooks entry. Neither one passes orders to the other.

items.q: Do our customers have to change what they do?
items.a: Only the ones you choose. Fresho says its OrderPilot AI lets customers carry on ordering exactly as they always have, and the Fresho portal is there too. Let each account pick: our app suits the kitchens that prefer to talk. One limit: a call or a voicemail to your desk gets no number, no timestamp and no stock update from us. Only what comes through our app does.

items.q: How fast could this be running?
items.a: For most distributors this takes 24 to 48 hours, and most kitchens have ordered by the end of day one. There is no setup project, and Fresho stays untouched while the first accounts start.

They are the most open about this of anyone we look at: a published starting figure, a setup fee, worked examples and a calculator, with prices by region. We publish nothing and give you a quote instead. Since Fresho stays, ask us to quote just our part.

items.q: Where do the Fresho details on this page come from?
items.a: Read off fresho.com as it stood on 10 October 2026: the modules they list, the order automation description, the category guides and the pricing page. Their saving figures and review scores belong to them and are not repeated here as results. If any of it has changed, the mistake is at our end.

mainCta.h2: Change how kitchens send orders, keep the rest
mainCta.body: Twenty minutes and one voice order, from the kitchen to your desk.
